recognize_zh: 這是 Kaplan-Meier 整體存活曲線（非形態學影像）：DLBCL 移植後復發時依年齡校正 IPI 分組，aaIPI 0–1（紅線，長期約 60%）存活明顯優於 aaIPI 2–3（藍線，約 36%），p < 0.0001。
features: Kaplan-Meier overall survival curves over about 72 months
Red curve: age-adjusted IPI 0-1, about 72% at 4 years and plateau near 60%
Blue curve: age-adjusted IPI 2-3, early steep decline to about 60% at 2 years and about 36% at 5-6 years
describe_en: This non-morphologic figure shows Kaplan-Meier overall survival for patients with relapsed diffuse large B-cell lymphoma stratified by the age-adjusted International Prognostic Index (aaIPI) at the time of relapse. Patients with aaIPI 0-1 had markedly better survival, plateauing at about 60%, than those with aaIPI 2-3, whose survival fell to about 36% (p < 0.0001). The separation appears early, within the first 12 months, indicating that the aaIPI at relapse remains a strong prognostic factor in the transplant setting.
